points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 诸葛亮出生于琅琊阳都（今山东临沂市沂南县），幼年父母双亡，由叔父诸葛玄抚养。叔父去世后，诸葛亮与弟弟诸葛均隐居在荆州襄阳城西的隆中（今湖北襄阳）。在此期间，他刻苦学习，博览群书，尤其精通兵法、天文、地理等知识，形成了自己独特的政治军事思想。这段隐居生活使诸葛亮得以深入思考天下大势，形成了著名的'隆中对'战略构想，为他日后辅佐刘备奠定了思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Yangdu, Langya (present-day Yinan County, Linyi, Shandong), Zhuge Liang lost his parents at a young age and was raised by his uncle Zhuge Xuan. After his uncle's death, Zhuge Liang and his younger brother Zhuge Jun lived in seclusion in Longzhong (west of present-day Xiangyang, Hubei). During this period, he studied diligently, reading extensively, and mastered military strategy, astronomy, and geography. This seclusion allowed him to deeply contemplate the political situation of the time, forming his famous 'Longzhong Dui' strategic plan, which laid the foundation for his later service to Liu Bei.

points.title: 三顾茅庐
points.titleEn: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage
points.description: 207年，刘备经徐庶推荐，三次前往隆中拜访诸葛亮，最终在第三次会面时见到了这位隐士。诸葛亮向刘备提出了著名的'隆中对'战略，建议刘备先取荆州，再取益州，联合东吴，对抗曹操，三分天下。这一战略构想得到了刘备的高度认可，诸葛亮遂出山辅佐刘备，担任军师。208年，曹操南下攻打荆州，诸葛亮促成孙刘联盟，在赤壁之战中大败曹军，奠定了三国鼎立的基础。这一时期，诸葛亮充分展示了自己的政治和军事才能，成为刘备集团的核心智囊。
points.descriptionEn: In 207, Liu Bei, recommended by Xu Shu, visited Zhuge Liang three times in Longzhong, finally meeting him on the third visit. Zhuge Liang presented his famous 'Longzhong Dui' strategy to Liu Bei, advising him to first take Jingzhou, then Yizhou, ally with Sun Quan in the east, and oppose Cao Cao to divide China into three kingdoms. This strategic plan was highly appreciated by Liu Bei, who then recruited Zhuge Liang as his military advisor. In 208, when Cao Cao attacked Jingzhou, Zhuge Liang facilitated the Sun-Liu alliance, achieved a major victory at the Battle of Red Cliffs, and laid the foundation for the Three Kingdoms' tripartite standoff. During this period, Zhuge Liang fully demonstrated his political and military talents, becoming the core strategist of Liu Bei's group.

points.title: 治理蜀汉
points.description: 214年，诸葛亮随刘备入蜀，协助刘备夺取益州，建立蜀汉政权。219年，刘备自称汉中王，任命诸葛亮为军师将军。222年，刘备夷陵之战失败后，病重于白帝城，临终前托孤于诸葛亮，嘱其'君自取之'，表明了极大的信任。223年，刘备去世，刘禅继位，诸葛亮受封武乡侯，开府治事，成为蜀汉的实际统治者。在成都期间，诸葛亮推行了一系列改革措施，包括发展农业、兴修水利、整顿吏治、制定《蜀科》等，使蜀汉社会稳定，经济得到恢复和发展。他还注重人才培养，提拔了蒋琬、费祎、董允等贤臣，为蜀汉的长治久安奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 214, Zhuge Liang followed Liu Bei into Shu (present-day Sichuan), helping him capture Yizhou and establish the Shu Han regime. In 219, after Liu Bei declared himself King of Hanzhong, he appointed Zhuge Liang as General of Military Advisors. After Liu Bei's defeat at the Battle of Yiling in 222 and subsequent illness at Bidi City, he entrusted Zhuge Liang with the care of his son Liu Shan on his deathbed, saying 'You may take the throne yourself,' showing immense trust. In 223, after Liu Bei's death, Liu Shan ascended the throne, and Zhuge Liang was enfeoffed as Marquis of Wuxiang and established his own office to handle affairs, becoming the de facto ruler of Shu Han. During his time in Chengdu, Zhuge Liang implemented a series of reforms, including agricultural development, water conservancy projects, official system rectification, and the creation of 'Shu Ke' (Shu Code), stabilizing Shu Han society and promoting economic recovery and development. He also focused on talent cultivation, promoting capable officials like Jiang Wan, Fei Yi, and Dong Yun, laying the foundation for Shu Han's long-term stability.

points.title: 北伐中原
points.description: 227年，诸葛亮上《出师表》，率军北伐，驻扎汉中。从228年到234年，他先后进行了五次北伐，试图实现'兴复汉室，还于旧都'的夙愿。在北伐过程中，诸葛亮展现了卓越的军事才能，创造了空城计、木牛流马等军事奇迹，并在街亭之战中重创魏将张郃。然而，由于国力有限、内部矛盾以及魏国的强大防御，北伐最终未能成功。234年，诸葛亮在五丈原（今陕西宝鸡岐山县）病逝，享年54岁。临终前，他安排了后事，将军队安全撤回蜀汉。北伐虽然未能实现统一天下的目标，但极大地消耗了魏国国力，维护了蜀汉的安全，也彰显了诸葛亮'鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已'的精神。
points.descriptionEn: In 227, Zhuge Liang submitted the 'Chushi Biao' (Memorial on Dispatching the Troops) and led his army on northern expeditions, based in Hanzhong. From 228 to 234, he launched five northern expeditions, attempting to fulfill his lifelong ambition of 'restoring the Han dynasty and returning to the old capital.' During these campaigns, Zhuge Liang demonstrated outstanding military talent, creating military miracles such as the 'Empty Fort Strategy' and inventing the 'wooden ox and flowing horse' (early mechanical transportation). He also severely defeated Wei general Zhang He at the Battle of Jieting. However, due to limited national power, internal conflicts, and Wei's strong defenses, the northern expeditions ultimately failed. In 234, Zhuge Liang fell ill and died at Wuzhangyuan (present-day Qishan County, Baoji, Shaanxi) at the age of 54. Before his death, he arranged posthumous matters and safely withdrew the army back to Shu Han. Although the northern expeditions failed to achieve the goal of unifying China, they greatly depleted Wei's national power, protected Shu Han's security, and demonstrated Zhuge Liang's spirit of 'serving with utmost devotion until death.'

points.title: 病逝遗志
points.description: 234年秋，诸葛亮在五丈原（今陕西宝鸡岐山县）病逝，享年54岁。临终前，他安排了后事，将军队安全撤回蜀汉，并推荐蒋琬、费祎等人继任丞相之位。诸葛亮去世后，蜀汉举国哀悼，百姓为之罢市巷哭。他的遗体被运回成都安葬，葬于定军山（今陕西勉县）。诸葛亮一生鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已，被后世誉为'忠臣典范'、'智慧化身'。他的政治、军事思想对后世产生了深远影响，其著作《诸葛亮集》成为中国古代重要的军事和政治文献。在民间传说和文学作品中，诸葛亮被神化为'多智而近妖'的形象，成为中国文化中智慧的象征。
points.descriptionEn: In the autumn of 234, Zhuge Liang died of illness at Wuzhangyuan (present-day Qishan County, Baoji, Shaanxi) at the age of 54. Before his death, he arranged posthumous matters, safely withdrew the army back to Shu Han, and recommended Jiang Wan and Fei Yi to succeed him as Chancellor. After Zhuge Liang's death, the entire Shu Han nation mourned, and the people stopped market activities and wept in the streets. His body was transported back to Chengdu for burial at Dingjun Mountain (present-day Mian County, Shaanxi). Throughout his life, Zhuge Liang served with utmost devotion until his death, and was later honored by posterity as a 'model of loyalty' and 'embodiment of wisdom.' His political and military thoughts had a profound impact on later generations, and his collected works 'Zhuge Liang Ji' became an important military and political document in ancient China. In folklore and literary works, Zhuge Liang was deified as a 'wise to the point of being almost demonic' figure, becoming a symbol of wisdom in Chinese culture.

supporter.zh: 诸葛亮被后世誉为'千古第一贤相'，是中国历史上杰出的政治家、军事家。他忠诚于蜀汉，鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已，辅佐刘备建立蜀汉政权，并在刘禅时期执掌朝政。诸葛亮推行的一系列改革措施使蜀汉社会稳定，经济繁荣，人才辈出。他的军事才能卓越，在赤壁之战、北伐等战役中展现了非凡的智慧。诸葛亮还注重农业发展，兴修水利，制定法律，为蜀汉的长治久安奠定了基础。他的'鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已'的精神成为后世忠臣的典范，影响深远。
supporter.en: Zhuge Liang is revered by later generations as 'the greatest chancellor in a thousand years' and was an outstanding statesman and military strategist in Chinese history. He remained loyal to Shu Han, serving with utmost devotion until his death. He assisted Liu Bei in establishing the Shu Han regime and later controlled the court during Liu Shan's reign. The series of reforms he implemented stabilized Shu Han society, promoted economic prosperity, and nurtured talented officials. His exceptional military talent was demonstrated in battles such as Red Cliffs and the Northern Expeditions. Zhuge Liang also emphasized agricultural development, water conservancy projects, and legal systems, laying the foundation for Shu Han's long-term stability. His spirit of 'serving with utmost devotion until death' became a model for loyal officials throughout Chinese history.

critic.zh: 诸葛亮也有其历史局限性。首先，他过于谨慎，错失了一些战机，如在北伐中未能采纳魏延的子午谷奇谋。其次，他对刘禅的过度保护可能阻碍了后主的成长，导致蜀汉后期人才匮乏。第三，诸葛亮在用人方面存在一定偏袒，如对杨仪的过度信任和对魏延的猜忌。此外，他的北伐战略虽然体现了忠诚，但在国力有限的情况下，频繁北伐消耗了蜀汉的国力，加速了蜀汉的衰落。从现代角度看，诸葛亮的一些决策如严刑峻法、过度集权等也存在争议。
critic.en: Zhuge Liang also had his historical limitations. First, he was overly cautious, missing some opportunities, such as rejecting Wei Yan's daring plan to attack through the Zi Valley during the northern expeditions. Second, his excessive protection of Liu Shan may have hindered the growth of the young ruler, leading to a shortage of talented officials in later years of Shu Han. Third, he showed favoritism in personnel matters, such as excessive trust in Yang Yi and suspicion of Wei Yan. Additionally, although his northern expeditions demonstrated loyalty, they consumed Shu Han's limited national resources and accelerated its decline. From a modern perspective, some of his decisions, such as harsh punishments and excessive centralization of power, are also controversial.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，诸葛亮是一个复杂而多面的形象。历史上，他是一位杰出的政治家和军事家，其治国理政的才能和忠诚精神值得肯定。然而，他也有其局限性，如过于谨慎、用人偏颇等。在流行文化中，诸葛亮被进一步神化，成为智慧的化身，如《三国演义》中的'多智而近妖'形象。这种神化虽然偏离了历史真实，但反映了人们对智慧、忠诚和鞠躬尽瘁精神的向往。现代研究更注重从多角度评价诸葛亮，既肯定其历史贡献，也分析其决策的局限性，形成更加全面客观的历史认知。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Zhuge Liang is a complex and multifaceted figure. Historically, he was an outstanding statesman and military strategist whose governance abilities and loyal spirit deserve recognition. However, he also had limitations, such as being overly cautious and showing favoritism in personnel matters. In popular culture, Zhuge Liang has been further deified as the embodiment of wisdom, such as the 'wise to the point of being almost demonic' image in the novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms.' Although this deification deviates from historical reality, it reflects people's admiration for wisdom, loyalty, and the spirit of serving with utmost devotion. Modern research tends to evaluate Zhuge Liang from multiple perspectives, acknowledging his historical contributions while analyzing the limitations of his decisions, forming a more comprehensive and objective historical understanding.

self.en: I will serve with utmost devotion until my death.

others.zh: 孔明之才，管、乐之亚匹也。然性骄矜，恃才放旷，此其所以取祸也。
others.en: Zhuge Liang's talent is second only to that of Guan Zhong and Yue Yi. However, his arrogant nature and reliance on his talent led to his downfall.
